summary: Rebuilt the quotes stage to the record: L8 (whole dollars in the accept sentence, thank-you page, signed page, signed PDF and signed/office emails), L9 (the headline is the recommended option everywhere: office list, phone, sync model_total_price, the quote; a picked option that is hidden recommends the next one shown), L12 (quote numbers PREFIX-YEAR-0001-v1 from a counter: next_quote_number(year), security definer, pinned search_path, service role only; quote_number_counters; quote_number_prefix seeded KN; the year in the business zone; a new version keeps its number; legacy numbers still show and are found on the phone), L13 (Valid until is the business-zone date of the last moment the link works; the expired page says the date and time it stopped; expires_at unchanged), L30 (409 setup_incomplete while the business profile has a gap; new /admin/business page, owner edits and office reads; the phone's Send checklist names the gaps from its bundle), L31 (new quotes store a consent sentence naming the profile's state; quotes sent before keep theirs), L32 (new estimates start in the profile's town, else the shop address's, else blank), L33 (the thank-you page says the copy was emailed only when it was; the PDF says 'the link we sent you'), L39 (an option block stays on one PDF page). One money formatter and one date-formatter module (lib/format.ts) on every quote surface. Hard rule 1 is kept by a document format marker: a document sent before (no format) prints exactly as it did. Proved on the 77 stored quotes of the live export (read-only, people replaced in the query): 2,926 rendered files (pages in every state, PDFs, emails) identical before and after this stage, and their PDFs and emails (1,386 files) identical to the live site's code. 10,000 random quotes at seed 20261118: every rule 0, including same_price_text (111,893 -> 0) and valid_until_is_expiry (1,626 -> 0). No price moved: golden option totals unchanged; one live draft's office headline moves to Better ($2,020 -> $2,730, the record's c6b22b65 example). All checks pass, e2e 265 ok.

Deploying this code with the migration stops quote sending on the live site until the owner fills in the license, office phone, state and warranty (L30, intended). Fill the profile right after deploying.
The business time zone is still the America/New_York constant in lib/format.ts (record follow-up). Quote numbers' year, Valid until and every date use it.

Legacy text kept in code for quotes sent before: LEGACY_ESIGN_CONSENT names Delaware and legacyQuoteNumber writes 'KN-'. Both are used only for documents without a format (hard rule 1); new quotes take the state and prefix from settings. The demo seed (lib/demo/seed.ts) also keeps its Delaware towns and numbers demo history the old way, so it never takes a real counter number.

The 16 stored live quotes whose printed Valid until is a day after their link stops keep that date, and their expired page says it (hard rule 1). Keeping their links open to the end of the printed day would make the paper true; owner question.
A counter number taken for a send that then fails (for example the PDF upload) is not reused, so numbers are unique but can skip.

The record's sendChecks.ts checklist with Fix buttons and price approvals (L34) is not part of this stage; the existing checklist gained one profile line and a link to the profile for owner and office.

ownerQuestions: License number required before a quote can go out (record). Some states do not license insulation contractors; default kept: required.
Consent wording '(ESIGN Act and <State> UETA)': New York did not adopt UETA; have counsel confirm the sentence before a franchise in such a state. Default kept: the record's wording.
Quote number prefix KN, the one quotes already carry; each franchise sets its own on the Business profile page. Default kept: KN.
One state in the profile serves both the e-sign sentence and new estimates. Default kept; a second field can be added for a franchise licensed in one state that mostly works in another.
The 16 stored live quotes that print a Valid until one day after their link stops: keep as sent (default, hard rule 1), or keep those links open to the end of the printed day.
Office staff can view but not edit the business profile. Default kept: owner only.
Logo, office email and website are optional for sending. Default kept.
